stages.title: Stage 35 — Reverse Engineering Security Features
stages.subtitle: Static/Dynamic Analysis Inquiry Checklist & Audit Steps

details.title: Static & Dynamic Analysis Checklist
items: Identifying Permission checks in application and framework code
Analyzing SELinux policy denials and domain constraints
Auditing Keystore key creation, storage, and usage restrictions
Inspecting Cryptographic API calls (AES/RSA cipher initialization, IV generation)
Auditing Certificate validation and Certificate Pinning implementation
Parsing Network Security Configuration XML files
Decompiling and locating application integrity verification routines
Identifying root/emulator/debug detection logic in DEX and Native (.so) binaries
Locating native security checks and memory hardening configurations

details.title: Application Audit Inquiry
items: Which permissions protect this target feature?
Is security enforcement executed in the app, framework, or system service?
Does data protection rely on Keystore or hardware-backed (TEE/StrongBox) keys?
Are there runtime integrity or environment checks guarding execution?
Where are cryptographic operations performed (Java, JNI native library, remote server)?
Is sensitive user data properly protected at rest (CE/DE storage, encrypted DB) and in transit (TLS 1.3, pinning)?
